question: What is the significance of the twelve cognitions in the deity's power-wheel?
premises: In these twelve the whole is completed.
This constitutes the principal power-wheel of the God of gods.
inference: The twelve cognitions form the primary wheel of powers in which the entirety of manifestation is comprehensively contained.
plain_english: Twelve cognitions are taught, and in them everything is completed; this is the principal wheel of powers of the God of gods.
